name: Three-Sigma AABB Blended Radius
definition: Computes a blended radius for an Axis-Aligned Bounding Box (AABB) representing a splat, combining volume-equivalent and RMS radii with an aspect penalty.
summary: Three-Sigma AABB Blended Radius computes a per-splat geometric bound by blending volume-equivalent and RMS radii with an aspect penalty to tightly enclose visual influence.
